contract: v7 MEDULLA TIMING arm: PREREGISTRATION, frozen and committed before any v7 fit, held-out evaluation or simulation. Science card A (motion vision), 10 Oct 2026.
hypothesis: The v6 S3 null (T4/T5 0.33 mV, no direction selectivity) is caused by uncalibrated temporal properties of the T4/T5 input stage. If Mi1, Tm3 (ON) and Tm1, Tm2 (OFF), measured INSIDE the unchanged network, reproduce their published in vivo voltage filters, the frozen S3 motion test should pass.
label: EXPLORATORY. Inherits the S1-A3 photoreceptor stage (FIT REJECTED, held-out 2/4, TRANSFER FAIL) and the S2-A-leak40 lamina/medulla parameters (hypothetical). v7 adds the first held-out-testable medulla calibration; it never upgrades S1/S2.

heldout.source: Behnia et al. 2014 Fig. 2 1 s flash column (digitised) + Extended Data Fig. 1c ratios from the text
heldout.isolation: read only by scripts/v7/heldout_v7.py, once, after the fitted parameter file is frozen and committed; fit_v7.py and v7_data.py never import or open it (tests/test_v7_medulla.py).

data.split_rationale: training = flicker about a mean (adapted, linear-filter regime); held-out = flashes from darkness (step, rectification and amplitude regime). Same lab, not guaranteed different animals: the hold-out tests generalisation across stimulus class, not across preparations.

base_params.why: the exact parameter set the frozen S3 rerun1 tested, so v7 differs from the v6 comparator ONLY in the fitted entries below

free_parameters.tau: membrane time constant per type (graded single compartment); bounds = the S2 bounds
free_parameters.leak_rest: leak reversal per recorded type, bounds = the pooled resting range -70..-40 mV used in S2 (Behnia held cells near -60 mV); rest, leak reversal and E_inh (-70 mV, global) stay distinct
free_parameters.gain: EFFECTIVE linear release gain of L1 and L2 (the main presynaptic types of Mi1/Tm3 and Tm1/Tm2), a per-type presynaptic quantity; never a weight. Sets the absolute mV scale the S2 calcium fit could not see.
free_parameters.graded_release: release FUNCTION stays as in v6: linear for L1/L2 and for Mi1/Tm3/Tm1/Tm2 (gain 1). The recorded cells' own output release is NOT identifiable from somatic voltage and is not fitted; a sigmoid for L1/L2 is not identifiable from linear filters (rectification is held-out territory). Both are disclosed non-identifiable and fixed.
free_parameters.fixed: graph and every edge/base weight (graph 4b2f87cc...091d01); R1-R6 phototransduction and release (S1-A3); L1/L2 Ih and e_leak (-40, leak40); L3, L4, L5, Mi4, Mi9, Tm4, Tm9 and all other types as in the base file

stimulus.fit_cutout: the frozen S2 7-column cutout (scripts/v6/fit_s2.build_cutout: central right-eye column (17,27) + 6 neighbours; 13 lamina/medulla types + R1-R6; no T4/T5; external inputs absent, disclosed)
stimulus.noise: full-field (all cutout R1-R6 equal): encoder = 10 (1 + s(t)), s from v7_data.behnia_noise
stimulus.mean_luminance_mapping: Behnia's 250 cd m^-2 mean is mapped to BG-1 (encoder 10, the S2 and S3 gray). ASSUMPTION, not a measurement; disclosed risk (adaptation sets filter speed).
stimulus.heldout_flash: dark (encoder 0) 3000 ms settle, 1000 ms pre, 1000 ms at encoder 20 (= 2m), 1500 ms post; offset window 727 ms (heldout_v7.py)

observation_model.readout: somatic V (mV) of the central-column Mi1, Tm3, Tm1, Tm2 (v6 is single-compartment: soma = cell); 1 ms samples
observation_model.transform: 0.008 Hz first-order high-pass, then the data's own estimator: K(w)=<R S*>/(<S S*>+eps), 5 s zero-padded snippets every 100 ms, eps = 1 % of mean <S S*>, lags 0-219 ms (v7_data.observe_filter). No calcium, no normalisation: absolute mV contrast^-1 ms^-1.
observation_model.objective: mean over the 4 types of mean over lags 0-219 ms of ((K_model - K_data)/sigma_t)^2, sigma_t = max(sqrt(sem_t^2 + sigma_dig^2), sigma_floor)

optimiser.method: scipy Powell, bounded, transformed parameters (log for log-scale)
optimiser.start_0: base values (tau from the base file, e_leak -52 where unset, gain 1)
optimiser.starts_1_3: Latin hypercube in the transformed box
optimiser.selection: lowest training objective over completed starts; tie -> lowest start index (fit_v7.select)
optimiser.resources: CPU only, no GPU; one process per start, 4 processes, NUMBA_NUM_THREADS=1, nice, taskset -c 0-3

compute_budget.fit: ~1.3 s per evaluation (13 s simulated on the 97-cell cutout; S2 measured 0.33 s per 3.5 s), 3000 evaluations x 4 starts = ~4.4 core-h, ~1.1 h wall on 4 cores; hard cap 3 h wall per start (a start over the cap is terminated and recorded NOT EVALUABLE)
compute_budget.s3: 4 CPU processes x ~2.3 h (rerun1: 8312-8416 s each) = ~9.3 core-h, ~2.3 h wall on 4 cores

training.A1: per-type NRMSE(K_model, K_data) <= 0.35 for all four types
training.A2: |model peak - digitised peak| <= 2 x text s.e.m. + 5 ms, all four
training.A3: peak(Mi1) - peak(Tm3) >= 5 ms AND peak(Tm1) - peak(Tm2) >= 5 ms
training.A4: main-lobe polarity correct for all four (Mi1/Tm3 +, Tm1/Tm2 -)
training.TRAIN_PASS: A1 and A2 and A3 and A4 (v7_data.train_gates)

heldout.H1: polarity: Mi1/Tm3 depolarise at onset and hyperpolarise at offset; Tm1/Tm2 the reverse; all four
heldout.H2: weak/strong ratio within text mean +/- 2 population s.d. (s.e.m. x sqrt n), lower bound 0; >= 3 of 4
heldout.H3: strong-polarity peak within a factor 2 of the digitised Fig. 2 value; >= 3 of 4

sequence: 1 fit (4 starts) -> select -> commit params_v7.json and its sha256 (frozen)
2 held-out evaluation once on the frozen file -> report
4 S3 rerun only if TRAIN_PASS; labelled 'calibration validated' only if HELDOUT_PASS too, otherwise 'calibration NOT validated'. Results reported whatever they show.

downstream_s3.protocol: UNCHANGED frozen S3 prereg qualification/v6/S3_prereg.json (9658283e...) and addendum 1 (ac445682...): same runner, encoder, lattices (axial-v1 and malecns-hex-v2, both reported), conditions dir0-dir315 + yaw_ccw/yaw_cw, windows, analysis and gates G1-G3/EXPLORATORY_PASS. The only change is --params params_v7.json --params-sha256 <frozen sha>, recorded in a v7 S3 addendum committed before launch.
downstream_s3.command: nice taskset -c 0-3 python scripts/v6/measure_tuning_v6.py --engine v6 --params qualification/v7/params_v7.json --params-sha256 <frozen> --prereg qualification/v6/S3_prereg.json --prereg-sha256 9658283e34b1c846b07c7631fc7853b4f06f7ddfbe0e38d329f9c243f99f946e --lattice <arm> --tag v7_<arm>_<A|B> --outdir <evidence-root>/flybrain-v7-evidence-<date>/S3_v7 --conditions <A: dir0,dir45,dir90,dir135,yaw_ccw | B: dir180,dir225,dir270,dir315,yaw_cw>; then merge_parts.py, s3_guard.py, analyse_tuning.py, s3_gates.py exactly as rerun1

v6_leak40_rerun1.note: merged S3 rerun1 NPZs, reused, not rerun; read FIRST (same backend, differs from v7 only in the fitted entries)

comparators_cpu.v5_gpu: reused descriptively only (66e23cd4..., 6581312a...); no new GPU job

falsification.F1_representation: no completed start reaches TRAIN_PASS: the network as modelled cannot reproduce the measured Mi1/Tm3/Tm1/Tm2 timing with per-type tau/leak/L-gain alone. Arm stops; no S3.
falsification.F2_generalisation: TRAIN_PASS but HELDOUT_PASS false: the fitted timing does not generalise to flashes; any S3 result is 'calibration NOT validated'.
falsification.F3_main: TRAIN_PASS and HELDOUT_PASS, yet EXPLORATORY_PASS (G1 and G2 and G3) is false on BOTH lattice arms: calibrated input-stage timing is not sufficient for direction selectivity in this model, and 'uncalibrated medulla timing caused the S3 null' is FALSIFIED.
falsification.support_not_proof: EXPLORATORY_PASS on >= 1 arm with TRAIN_PASS and HELDOUT_PASS is an exploratory observation needing independent replication (other data, e.g. a second mV source).

rules: No parameter, bound, start, objective, gate, window, data file or analysis change after any fit output is seen; a crash rerun is recorded with its reason; all starts, both lattice arms and all comparators are reported whatever they show. No GPU. <= 4 CPU cores.
